description: Check on or read a parse job started by submit_job. By default it returns the job's NDJSON records once it has completed: the same output parse_workbook returns, one JSON record per line. Pass wait_seconds (up to 60) to wait that long for a job still processing; if it is still processing after that, the call fails with job_not_ready, so call again. Pass status_only: true to get the status instead, without waiting: {job_id, status, created_at, updated_at, expires_at, bytes_in, records_out, stream_url, error}, where status is "processing", "completed" or "failed". A failed job returns its parse error, and an unknown or expired job_id, or one submitted with another API key, fails with not_found. Everything after `since` comes back in one result, with no paging; pass since to skip records you already have. parse_workbook returns its result directly and needs no job.

since.description: Number of records to skip from the start (the 0-based index of the first record to return; default 0)

status_only.description: Return the job's status instead of its records, without waiting (default false)

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for a job that is still processing (0-60, default 0: don't wait)

name: stream_job
title: Stream job output
